notes: Reconciled from two independent codings. The academic honesty policy mentions AI only in two definitions; its integrity-process units (meeting with student, penalties, appeal) are kept because they govern AI cases, and general procedures with no AI content were dropped. No school or computing-unit document was found, and the course layer is deferred. Five UNCOVERED units share two themes that the closed type list does not cover: duty to report policy violations and data incidents involving AI, and a notice rule for AI recording in staff meetings; a type for reporting AI incidents could be considered between batches. The policy text says annual review while collect metadata says next review 8/2027, and approval dates are 2026.
